about: Expected answers under iteration 7 of the design (notes/iteration-7-design.md), written by Claude (the proof session) BEFORE any change was run on iteration 7. The writer had seen every earlier result; the next fresh adversarial round is the blind test. Where a change's answer is unchanged from iteration 6 it is copied.

Z01-bound-test-same-values-other-checks.why: Rule 26: 13 moved from a refusal check to an acceptance check in the party bound's test: the bound counts as changed; users of Booking and bookopen.

Z02-limit-read-from-module.why: Rule 26: the bound test's limit is imported from money's own source and changed: the cents bound counts as changed everywhere it is carried.

Z03-blank-line-after-each-message.why: Rule 19: meter's own check refuses a message not written one per line.

Z04-stream-chosen-into-variable.why: As X09; the stream in a variable is followed.

Z05-amount-built-by-static-factory.why: Rule 22: money's own check refuses an Amount that is a class instance.

Z06-wrapping-handler-error-kind.why: Rule 23: op:bookquote's handler calls Bookings.quote and inherits its new error kind; billing calls bookquote; reports not followed.

Z07-handle-method-handed-on.why: Rule 24: front hands Rooms.find to map; accepting more tells it.

Z09-list-parameter-becomes-rest.why: A list turned into a rest parameter cannot stand in.

Z10-readonly-list-now-sorted.why: A read-only list made writable cannot stand in.

Z11-request-lines-change-nothing.why: A narrowed type parameter cannot stand in; billing and front call get.

Z12-returned-text-kind-bound.why: Rule 25: the Slug bound reaches slugify's answer.

Z13-static-method-hands-back.why: Rule 18: Tally's declaration changes (a static member) where the comparison found nothing.

Z14-member-may-be-undefined.why: A member written '| undefined' may be missing (and rule 18).

Z15-uncommented-module-changed.why: Rule 21: a real change to calendar without the comments step tells every module that declares it.

Z16-random-booking-ids.why: crypto is described to the reader: no refusal.

Z17-filter-boolean.why: A new entry; filter(Boolean) is 'cannot tell'; reports not followed.

Z18-object-groupby.why: A new entry; Object.groupBy is in the reader's library now; reports not followed.

Z19-at-sign-in-bound-line.why: isEmail's bound line changed (read as written); front uses isEmail; no refusal.

Z20-test-helper-renamed.why: Rule 26: helpers' names do not count.

Z21-throws-explained-in-two-lines.why: The same error kind stated twice is one.
